items.raw_excerpt: Felicity Guest says frozen child support payments are a result of suspicious activity
items.summary_en: A mother says her child support payments were frozen. Officials told her the freeze was caused by a system glitch. The system treated the payments as suspicious activity.
items.summary_ko: 한 어머니는 자신의 양육비 지급이 동결됐다고 말했다. 당국은 시스템 오류 때문에 지급이 중단됐다고 알렸다. 시스템이 해당 지급을 의심스러운 활동으로 처리했다.
items.title_en: Child support payments frozen by system glitch
items.title_ko: 아동 양육비 지급이 시스템 오류로 중단돼

items.raw_excerpt: The historic state of Puebla is the next destination in our tour of Mexico, where history, food and a touch of magic abound.
items.summary_en: The historic state of Puebla is the next stop in our tour of Mexico. History, food, and a touch of magic are everywhere here.

items.raw_excerpt: The vast brick exterior of the former Carrington Hospital in the Auckland suburb of Mt Albert is an impressive sight - from a distance.
items.summary_en: The old Carrington Hospital in Mt Albert, Auckland is a big brick building that has been left empty for a long time. It needs roof repairs. A protest group offered to raise money to pay for the fix.

items.raw_excerpt: Mount Barker is one of South Australia's fastest-growing districts, but while some businesses are excited about the prospect of more customers, others are competing with tightening wallets and operating pressures.
items.summary_en: Mount Barker is one of South Australia's fastest-growing districts. Some businesses look forward to more customers. Others are struggling with tighter budgets and higher operating costs.

items.raw_excerpt: Thick fog has disrupted flights at Auckland Airport.
items.summary_en: Thick fog hit Auckland Airport and forced flight cancellations and delays. Travelers should check with their airline before going to the airport.

items.raw_excerpt: The Tonga Rugby Union, Rugby Australia and the Australian Government have joined forces to stage the first rugby clash between the 'Ikale Tahi and a combined First Nations and Pasifika team in Nuku'alofa.
items.summary_en: The Tonga Rugby Union, Rugby Australia and the Australian Government are hosting the first rugby match between Tonga and a combined First Nations and Pasifika team. The game will take place in Nuku'alofa, Tonga.

items.raw_excerpt: Un itinerario tra i luoghi dell'anima del cantautore, dalle radici nell'Appennino alla Bologna delle osterie e della musica
items.summary_en: This story follows the places that inspired the songs of Italian singer-songwriter Francesco Guccini. It goes from his roots in the Apennine mountains to Bologna and its taverns and music. Fans can explore the spots that shaped his work.
items.summary_ko: 이 이야기는 이탈리아 싱어송라이터 프란체스코 구치니의 노래에 영감을 준 장소를 따라간다. 아펜니노 산맥의 뿌리에서 시작해 볼로냐의 선술집과 음악으로 이어진다. 팬들은 그의 작업에 영향을 준 곳들을 돌아볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: A walk through the places of Francesco Guccini's heart
items.title_original: I luoghi del cuore di Francesco Guccini: da Pavana a Bologna, il viaggio nei posti che hanno ispirato le sue canzoni - tg.la7.it
